description: Merge one world-graph entity into another - for duplicates like 'Selphina'/'Sylphina' created by mispronunciations. Moves aliases, mentions, timeline links, images and generation links to the target and archives the source. Use chargen_undo_entity_merge with the returned merge_id to reverse it; chargen_list_entity_merges reads merge history. Renaming the misspelling inside session text and recaps is separate - after merging, run chargen_preview_find_replace, then chargen_apply_find_replace with this merge_id. Manual merges may combine any non-Player entity types. The target survives and keeps its type. Players can receive only Players or NPCs, and a Player cannot merge into another type.

source_entity_id.description: Duplicate entity UUID to merge away
